title: Societal pairwise outcome
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function from sign profiles of length $n$ to $\\{ -1,+1 \\}$, and let $p$ be a profile of $n$ voters' strict rankings of candidates $a,b,c$. The societal outcome assigns to each of the three cyclic pairwise contests the sign obtained by applying $f$ to the voters' signs in that contest.
hypotheses_covered: a Boolean function on sign profiles of length $n$
